Title: Client-side mock login accepts arbitrary invalid passwords without validation
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to #/login
2. Enter email user@test.com
3. Enter arbitrary wrong password 'totallyWrongPassword!@#'
4. Click Login button
Expected Result: Application must reject invalid credentials and show error message 'Invalid credentials'
Actual Result: Application generates JWT token and redirects user directly to #/dashboard
Notes: Evidence: screenshots/defects/DEF-001-wrong-password-accepted.png | Discovered via Playwright automated test TC-012

Title: Browser back button displays cached dashboard content after session logout
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login as valid user (user@test.com)
2. Verify dashboard loads
3. Clear session/token
4. Press browser Back button
Expected Result: Client-side router should intercept history navigation and redirect unauthenticated user to #/login
Actual Result: Dashboard content ('Commuter Command Center' and 'Active Bookings') remains rendered from client state cache
Notes: Evidence: screenshots/defects/DEF-002-back-button-session-leak.png | Discovered via Playwright automated test SEC-015
